identification: The giant constrained ritual body of the Conjurer at the edge of the final arena, distinct from the mobile Walter. The authorised Piggyback guide calls this figure Big Walter.
verdict: Both hands and the torso are documented together in a new still. The upper suspension strands terminate outside the frame. A PS2 recording corroborates that the body is fixed and shows the changing front during the ritual, but its lateral and upper attachments remain cut. Evidence does not determine a complete isolated exterior for either state.

evidence.sourceNature: Game-image reproduction in a secondary retrospective; angle and extraction method not documented.
evidence.observation: Front three-quarter. Both human-like hands and narrowing torso are readable. The long pale fixtures protrude beyond the top boundary.

evidence.sourceNature: PlayStation 2 final battle gameplay recording by Velpa Challenger, original-scale 320 × 180 player storyboard cell.
evidence.observation: Fixed body visible beside the arena edge. Its upper extreme leaves the frame and the intervening environment covers parts of the support.

otherSourceInspected.result: The filming of a television makes the dark upper region and screen limits less reliable. No clearer complete outline.
